cohort: 108 pregnant women who underwent Caesarean Section surgery were recruited and divided into three groups.
finding: Sub-anesthetic dosages of intravenous ketamine (0.15 mg/kg and 0.3 mg/kg) augmented postoperative analgesia and decreased the overall intake of rescue analgesics within 24 hours following caesarean section, with the 0.3 mg/kg dosage significantly prolonging the duration until the first request for postoperative analgesic medication.
